title: Studying clarinet with Professor Chalini
summary: He began study with a post-office worker and former trumpeter, learning the Albert-system clarinet with fingering first.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: But it was a funny thing. When I began to study, I studied under an old professor, and that particular time he was in the post office. And his hobby, he'd always loved music, as a matter of fact he played music himself. And I should think there was more or less a sideline for him.
And his name was, I don't remember his first name, but his last name was Shalini.

Old Man Shalini they used to call him. He used to be a wonderful trumpet man. And of course he played on the old style along with the old fellas, like Mania Perez and that bunch. What did you study with him? I studied clarinet. I studied clarinet, the old Albert system under him.
How did he teach? Did he make you learn self-edged and ear training and sight singing first, or started you right on the instrument?

Well he started me on the instrument first. First the fingering and how to fingering instrument, basic foundation of the instrument at first. But of course he didn't have too much knowledge I think of ear training at that time, because all the facilities were very poor as far as learning was concerned. You couldn't get the proper methods you want to, or you could study by. And of course I think he had a very wonderful knowledge of music, wherein he taught more than one particular instrument. As a matter of fact he taught clarinet, saxophone, trombone, trumpet, and maybe some form or phases of piano. But of course at that time my brother and myself, we were attending his school at the time.
